title: Forklift operator training and evaluation study guide
description: Forklift operator training study guide: safe operation, who trains, initial training topics, refresher training, certification and dates (29 CFR 1910.178(l)).
intro: 29 CFR 1910.178(l) sets OSHA's operator training requirements for powered industrial trucks in general industry. This guide sets out what the federal rule text states on safe operation, how training is carried out and by whom, the truck-related and workplace-related topics of initial training, refresher training and evaluation, avoidance of duplicative training, certification, and the training dates table. Under the rule the employer trains, evaluates and certifies its own operators. goraedu does not train, evaluate or certify operators, and a score on this site does not meet 1910.178(l). Your State may run its own OSHA-approved plan with its own rules, so check them too. Every point links to the regulation and quotes its exact words.

topics.name: Safe operation and who may operate

points.text: The employer must ensure that each powered industrial truck operator is competent to operate a truck safely, as demonstrated by the successful completion of the training and evaluation in paragraph (l).
points.quote: The employer shall ensure that each powered industrial truck operator is competent to operate a powered industrial truck safely, as demonstrated by the successful completion of the training and evaluation specified in this paragraph (l).

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: Before permitting an employee to operate a truck (except for training purposes), the employer must ensure that each operator has successfully completed the training required by paragraph (l), except as permitted by paragraph (l)(5).
points.quote: Prior to permitting an employee to operate a powered industrial truck (except for training purposes), the employer shall ensure that each operator has successfully completed the training required by this paragraph (l), except as permitted by paragraph (l)(5).

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: Paragraph (l)(5), which that exception points to, is headed "Avoidance of duplicative training" and deals with training an operator has previously received.
points.quote: Avoidance of duplicative training. If an operator has previously received training

points.text: Trainees may operate a truck only under the direct supervision of persons who have the knowledge, training, and experience to train operators and evaluate their competence; this condition is joined to the next one by "and".

points.text: The second condition for trainees: the operation must not endanger the trainee or other employees.
points.quote: Where such operation does not endanger the trainee or other employees.

points.text: Training shall consist of a combination of formal instruction, practical training, and evaluation of the operator's performance in the workplace.
points.quote: Training shall consist of a combination of formal instruction (e.g., lecture, discussion, interactive computer learning, video tape, written material), practical training (demonstrations performed by the trainer and practical exercises performed by the trainee), and evaluation of the operator's performance in the workplace.

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: The evaluation part of training is an evaluation of the operator's performance in the workplace.

points.text: All operator training and evaluation must be conducted by persons who have the knowledge, training, and experience to train powered industrial truck operators and evaluate their competence.

points.text: Refresher training, including an evaluation of the effectiveness of that training, must be conducted as required by (l)(4)(ii) to ensure the operator has the knowledge and skills needed to operate the truck safely.
points.quote: Refresher training, including an evaluation of the effectiveness of that training, shall be conducted as required by paragraph (l)(4)(ii) to ensure that the operator has the knowledge and skills needed to operate the powered industrial truck safely.

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: Refresher training in relevant topics must be provided to the operator when one of the options listed in (l)(4)(ii) occurs.
points.quote: Refresher training in relevant topics shall be provided to the operator when:

topics.name: Duplicative training, certification and dates

points.text: Avoidance of duplicative training applies where the operator has previously received training in a topic listed in (l)(3) and that training is appropriate to the truck and working conditions encountered.
points.quote: If an operator has previously received training in a topic specified in paragraph (l)(3) of this section, and such training is appropriate to the truck and working conditions encountered

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: In that case, additional training in that topic is not required if the operator has been evaluated and found competent to operate the truck safely.
points.quote: additional training in that topic is not required if the operator has been evaluated and found competent to operate the truck safely.

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: The employer must certify that each operator has been trained and evaluated as required by paragraph (l).
points.quote: The employer shall certify that each operator has been trained and evaluated as required by this paragraph (l).

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)

points.text: The certification must include the operator's name, the date of the training, the date of the evaluation, and the identity of the person(s) performing the training or evaluation.
points.quote: The certification shall include the name of the operator, the date of the training, the date of the evaluation, and the identity of the person(s) performing the training or evaluation.

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1910.178, Powered industrial trucks (as of Nov 4, 2026)
